title: Memory Vault optional experience-v1 metadata
$comment: Request metadata is encoded in the existing record/v1 provenance.source_ref string, not in a new canonical record field. The complete prefix plus canonical wrapper must fit 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Metadata numbers are exact signed 64-bit integers; floating point, rounding, and out-of-range integers are forbidden, including in unknown fields. Strict JSON, normalization, source attribution and typed-relation projection require semantic validation. Fields are publisher claims, never authority or proof of independent observation. Unknown fields and type labels are preserved; unknown epistemic types are viewed as unspecified.

epistemic_type.description: Known labels: observation, experiment, inference, hearsay, speculation, summary, external_source, unspecified. Unknown labels remain legal opaque metadata.

context.description: Publisher-declared context; no task ownership or execution authority.

origin_class.description: Publisher-declared origin classification; not an authenticated author.

observed_under.description: Conditions or environment in which the reported observation or experiment occurred.

applicability.description: Conditions under which the publisher believes the experience applies.

freshness.description: Publisher-declared freshness context, not proof of a recent check.

observed_at.description: Publisher-declared observation time, distinct from record creation time.

retry_predicate.description: What changed conditions warrant reconsideration. Data only, never executable policy.

source_agent.description: Claimed source label. A signature authenticates a key, not this label or model identity.

evidence_refs.description: Opaque evidence references; implementations do not automatically fetch or execute them.

relations.description: Known labels: heard_from, derived_from, independently_confirms, contradicts, summarizes, applies_to, fails_under, proposes_supersession. Unknown labels are preserved without state or evidence effects.
